mutations.label: ADR-077 T1: a wait is bounded
mutations.from: turn = await lease.admit(leases, held, { maxMs: lease.waitMaxMs(env), stopped: () => stopped })
mutations.to: turn = await lease.admit(leases, held, { maxMs: lease.waitMaxMs(env) * 10, stopped: () => stopped })
mutations.only: ^a wait past its bound says so and runs, within the bound$

mutations.label: ADR-077 T1: a signal while waiting releases
mutations.only: ^a signal while waiting releases the lease and runs nothing$

mutations.label: ADR-077 T1: an unusable directory is said
mutations.from: stderr.write(`qh-check: could not use the lease: ${held.error}; running without one.\n`)
mutations.only: ^a lease directory that cannot be used is said, and the run proceeds$
